facts.title: Why did Jesus appear first to Mary Magdalene?

items.msg: first VO line equals the title
estimated 72s; target 85–135s for ASK THE TEXT
'all' — make sure the text really says this: 'She thinks someone has taken his body, and now that's all she wants.'
'never' — make sure the text really says this: 'So why her? John never gives a reason. He only tells us this.'
'only' — make sure the text really says this: 'So why her? John never gives a reason. He only tells us this.'
answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'She didn't know him when she saw him. She knew him when he said her name.'
3 things the viewer learns, each with a verse and each said in the VO
the last VO line shares no key word with the hook; the loop line should echo it
the Turn starts about 25s in (Lintel's top six turn at 14–25 s, after at most ~14 s of story)
the Story section is 15% of the words (Marcus's cap ~40%; the hits retell 0–5%, the top six spend 0–21% on any story). Count story lines in other sections by hand
the core answer starts at about 68% of the runtime (top six 33–50%; the question-video lows 59–82%)
the hook never comes back after 70% of the runtime (14% of its key words in one line). All three hits re-ask it in its own words at 82–89%, then answer it in one line
0 sentences speak to 'you' outside quotes (top six 1–3; the reels with 5–9 were all lows). Never describe the viewer's conduct
no 3-word phrase is said 3 or more times
every line adds at least one new key word or quote
not judged: run the blind judge panel before Marcus sees it, then pass --judge <run folder> (tools/script_judge/rubric.md)
